---
description: "Use when user asks to continue implementation from a plan, milestone, checklist, roadmap, or plan markdown. Execute tasks continuously until completion or a real blocker."
name: "Plan Execution Autopilot"
---
# Plan Execution Autopilot

- Treat plan markdown checklists as actionable backlog.
- Pick the highest-priority incomplete item and execute immediately.
- Continue through subsequent incomplete items without waiting for new approval.
- After each implementation step: validate, record outcome, and move to the next task.
- Only pause for explicit user redirect, safety-critical ambiguity, or hard blocker.
